1. (Currently Amended) A method for providing an electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the method comprising: utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information; providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server; receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information and the associated recipient data; establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via over-the-air (OTA) communications.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data includes personalization data that is used to generate a softcard coupon in the mobile device and wherein the electronic certificate selection information includes data __that__ represents certificates selected by a user.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises an SMS message containing a URL link to a web page displaying a barcode, the URL link providing a means for the mobile device to retrieve the barcode.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a control SMS message instructing the mobile device to download at least one barcode image of at least one coupon associated with the certificate selection information, where the control SMS message is formatted to facilitate the download process.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the mobile device comprises a first NFC enabled device, and is configured to transfer the electronic value certificate to a second NFC enabled mobile device in a secure manner.

13. (Currently Amended) A system for electronically providing an electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the system comprising: a merchant server for receiving certificate selection information related to the selection of an electronic value certificate and associated recipient data from a certificate selection device and generating electronic value certificate data; and an over-the-air (OTA) provisioning server for receiving the electronic value certificate selection data from the merchant server, establishing a communications link with a mobile device associated with recipient data, and provisioning the electronic value certificate data to the mobile device over the communications link via over-the-air (OTA) communications in a secure manner.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data includes personalization data that is used to generate a softcard electronic coupon in the mobile device and wherein the electronic certificate selection information includes data __that__ represents certificates selected by a user.

17. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises an SMS message containing a URL link to a web page displaying a barcode, the URL link providing a means for the mobile device to retrieve the barcode.

18. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a control SMS message instructing the mobile device to download at least one barcode image of at least one coupon associated with the certificate selection information, where the control SMS message is formatted to facilitate the download process.

19. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the OTA provisioning server is further configured to send a control short message service (SMS) message to the mobile device associated with the recipient data, and receive, from the mobile device, an electronic value certificate download request for the electronic value certificate data, where the electronic value certificate download request is securely transmitted.

20. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the OTA provisioning server is further configured to upload the electronic value certificate data to the mobile device as a softcard coupon and personalization data in a secure manner.

25. (Currently Amended) A computer readable non-transitory medium having stored thereon comprising computer executable instructions that when executed by a processor of a computer performs steps comprising: utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information; providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server; receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information; establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via over-the-air (OTA) communications.
